S-ENGINEERING.Purpose: Keep the FLI product understandable, cohesive, reproducible, and verifiable: repository organization, testing, validation, and distribution.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Repository cleanliness and physical organization contract.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Release-confidence validation process and release gates.

Principles.PRIN-001: Every persistent file has one obvious owner/place; physical organization expresses implementation responsibility, not semantic ontology.
Principles.PRIN-002: Observable invariant/user path over implementation-mirroring test volume; mechanical architecture enforcement over prose-only rules.
Principles.PRIN-003: Clean project stays unchanged; ambiguous evidence fails closed.
Principles.PRIN-004: Installation unity is not component coupling; component-specific tooling stays with its owner.

Requirements.REQ-001: Successful build/test without intentional product mutation leaves a clean repository status; program execution leaves no unmanaged persistent traces.
Requirements.REQ-002: The canonical skill lives once in `packages/skills`; integrations package/register it without semantic copies. Project-local skills live in `.agents/skills/` and are never distributed.
Requirements.REQ-003: Checkout-identical builds produce equal normalized content manifests; incidental timestamps/filesystem metadata are not content identity.
